text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the Academy—
I ran into Matikanefukukitaru, who was busily
spreading out a hiragana chart on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mufufu! This is a cutting-edge divine revelation
receiving method that I devised myself!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
First, you shake this plastic bottle vigorously!
Then the water droplets on the surface go splash-splash,
flying toward the hiragana chart on the ground!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And then... if you combine the wet characters,
the divine revelation is complete! That's how it works!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here goes!
Good Fortune Droplets, launch!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mumu?! The letters wet with droplets are...
"Fu", "Ko", and... "Ro".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I've got it! "Ko", "Ro", "Bu"—
Korobu, to fall down! In other words, good fortune
will come flying in from where you tumble!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How lucky for you, passing Trainer-san!
Let's head right over to the prime tumble spot
and take a spectacular fall!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I had no desire to take a fall whatsoever,
but got dragged along by her sheer momentum.
However, along the way—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is... is there...!
Is there really no salvation for meee...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-What's the matter?!
Doto-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
L-Lately, my tripping rate has shown
an abnormal spikeee...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Just a moment ago I tripped in the cafeteria
and scattered super spicy sauce everywhere...
Yesterday on the street, the day before in the bath—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Why do I keep tripping so much?
I'm truly utterly hopeless, uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry! We just received an oracle of
good fortune earlier, so Doto-san should also tu—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ! H-Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-If Doto-san tumbles, good fortune will come...
But tumbling is the very source of
Doto-san's troubles in the first place~...?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...No, wait? Hold on.
The oracle earlier was "Ko", "Ro", "Bu"—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If we rearrange and re-interpret this...
"Bukoro"... "Ro" "Kobu"...
"Rokobu"—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Six pieces of kelp (Roku-Kombu)?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand now! If we gather six pieces of kelp,
Doto-san's troubles will be solved!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-Is that really trueee?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Come on, let's head to the shopping district!
We must gather the chosen kelp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... S-Sorry to keep you waiting~!
We've finally obtained the sixth kelp,
the white-board kelp!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah, uuu~!
With this, I won't be tripping anymore, will I!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now that I'm relieved,
I suddenly feel weak in the knees... Huh, wait...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto wobbled and lost her balance.
Just as she was about to tumble over—
Matikanefukukitaru held out the kelp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ack, Doto-saaan!
Grab onto my kelp, quick~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah... uuu!
Thanks to that, I'm saved, uuu...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Praise be, praise be!
As expected of the divine Kelp-sama!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, um. There's that too, but...
My gratitude right now is for Fukukitaru-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You listened to my worries, searched for kelp with me,
and even saved me in a moment of danger...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
F-Fukukitaru-san... As I thought,
you're truly the greatest masteeeeer!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-W-What are you saying!
It's entirely thanks to the divine prophecy's blessing...
choice_data_list: This kelp is proof of your friendship.
This kelp is proof of your friendship.
That interpretation felt pretty forced though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-W-What are you saying!
It's entirely thanks to the divine prophecy's blessing...
choice_data_list: This kelp is proof of your friendship.
This kelp is proof of your friendship.
That interpretation felt pretty forced though...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I will treasure it forever!
As a lucky charm, never letting it leave my side—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bond of friendship between the two seemed
to grow even firmer. Yes, just like a sheet of dried kelp—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true at all!
I was just mistaken when I interpreted it as "tripping"—
the prophecy is always guiding us correctly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as Matikanefukukitaru stubbornly insisted—
regardless, it was a commotion that showcased
just how deeply she cares for her friends.
